title: Retain physical phase and chirp in all-order binary Stein-rank bounds at a positive density of source indices
short_pr_body:
## Result
Prove an all-order Stein-rank floor for selected physical two-point tensors, with phase/chirp retained and at least s-1-delta-2r^2-r good starting indices per axis.

## Checks
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-phase-binary-rank`
Independent review and negative controls passed. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Predecessors: #7000, #1786.

## Limits and credit
No new kappa; all five full assumptions remain. Unrounded, alias-deleted selected pairs; no arbitrary-phase, larger-tile, periodic, rounding-margin or full-caller transfer. Prepared for @CubeJerry; credit to cited predecessors and substantial OpenAI assistance.

[Full result, novelty, exact pins, checks and PR draft](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0a6315b71a47b37a4faa2a4f555c5bc4e9e87811/research/selected-phase-binary-rank/PR-DESCRIPTION.md)
